title: Revolut alternatives in the UAE: A guide to 5 options in 2026
summary: In this guide, we’ll look at 5 Revolut alternatives in the UAE – from Ziina to Careem Pay and Wio – to help you decide which one works best for you.
body_markdown:
Whether you’re paying for your morning coffee, shopping online, or sending money to family and friends, making payments in the UAE should feel simple.


But relying on bank transfers might add unnecessary hassle: you might need to swap 23-digit IBANs, and when you’re making a payment outside the UAE, marked-up exchange rates could potentially take a bigger bite out of your spending than you’d like.


The good news is that the right financial app can make payments simple and cost-effective every time, whether that’s locally or overseas.


If you’re looking for Revolut alternatives in the UAE, there are many options to choose from, each with its own strengths. In this article, we'll talk about five options to help you find one that works for you.


We’ll cover:


- What to look for in a Revolut alternative in the UAE


- Ziina Personal


- Wio Personal


- Careem Pay


- Liv Bank


- Wise


Ziina is a payments app built to help UAE residents easily send and receive money. When you


[sign up with Ziina](https://ziina.app.link/webBlog) , you’ll be able to create a virtual card, share payment links with friends, and spend up to 3,000 AED per month (or 20,000 AED for Ziina Violet members) on any non-AED purchases with no currency conversion fees.


## What to look for in a Revolut alternative in the UAE


While there’s no ‘best’ Revolut alternative, finding the right one for you comes down to how you use it.


For example, before deciding on a provider, here are some features to look out for:


- Transparent pricing:


This obviously includes per-transaction fees and subscription charges, but it also covers minimum balance requirements, initial loading fees, as well as any setup or closing fees that your provider might charge. All fees should be clearly listed and easy to find on your provider’s website.


- Clear currency conversion fees:


If you’ll be spending or receiving money in different currencies, make sure that you’re paying low (if any) conversion fees.


- Offers fast, human support:


Can you speak to a human as soon as an issue arises? Check how quickly the provider responds and whether support is available in the languages you need, such as English and Arabic.


- Easy to set up:


Some providers might ask you to visit in person so they can verify your identity (or have you sign paperwork), while others might let you


[sign up fully online in minutes](https://ziina.app.link/webBlog) .


- Offers a physical or virtual card:


Depending on how you plan to use your account, having access to a physical or virtual card can be useful. Physical cards can make ATM withdrawals easier, while virtual cards can be handy for online spending and adding to digital wallets like Apple Pay.


With that being said, here are some Revolut alternatives* in the UAE:


## Ziina Personal


Since we’re the ones writing this article, it makes sense to start with ourselves.


Ziina is the UAE’s first peer-to-peer payments platform that lets you easily send money to friends and family. Whether you’re just trying to split a payment quickly or you’re making a large lifestyle purchase, you can get paid with Ziina simply by swapping phone numbers – no IBANs, SWIFT codes, or bank transfers needed.


Just top up your Ziina wallet and start making payments right away. It’s that simple.


Here’s what you can do with Ziina:


### Sign up with an Emirates ID to start sending and receiving money quickly


Our payments app was built specifically for UAE residents – in fact, all you need to get started is your Emirates ID.


Your funds will appear in your Ziina wallet as soon as you receive a payment. For customers with the Ziina Card, withdrawing funds from your Ziina wallet to your linked bank account is near-instant. For others, it is up to 12 hours.


If you don’t want to cash out, you can also choose to send money straight to another Ziina account or spend directly from your balance by using our virtual card. Just add the card to an e-wallet like Apple Pay or Google Pay, and you’re ready to spend anywhere that Visa is accepted.


Please note that the Ziina Card is virtual, which means it can’t be used to physically withdraw cash from ATMs.


To keep you safe, we use two-factor authentication (2FA) to verify each payment. For example, we use face and fingerprint biometric scans, as well as PIN codes to ensure that all your transactions are legitimate.


We offer local customer support in both English and Arabic during UAE business hours. Our app interface is also available in both languages.


Pricing:


A Ziina Lite Personal account has no subscription fee, setup fee or minimum balance requirement. Transaction fees may apply, including 0.5% on foreign-currency spend above AED 3,000 per month. Sending money to another Ziina account is free.


### Share payment links with your friends and get paid quickly


If your friend group has ever gone on holiday together, then one person has probably paid on behalf of the group. But that often means that same person has to chase five different people for their share.


If you need an easy way to pay people back, you can use Ziina’s payment links to help everyone pay in a few taps. Your friends don't need a Ziina account to pay. They can just tap the link, choose their payment method, and complete the payment using Apple Pay, Google Pay, Visa, Mastercard, or Amex.


Some of our customers’ favourite features are the ability to send GIFs, photos, and personalized notes. These can make transactions more fun!

### Upgrade to Violet and access exclusive deals from 12 premium brands


[Ziina Violet](https://ziina.com/personal/plans/violet) is our premium lifestyle membership tier, which allows you to get up to 850 AED of value for 100 AED per month. For example, our Violet members can access exclusive benefits and deals like…


- Higher fee-free non-AED spend:


Pay zero currency conversion fees when you spend up to 20,000 AED per month in foreign currency. This fee-free limit will be applied to all foreign spending, including any online orders you make.


- Cashbacks:


When you spend with a Ziina Violet Card at participating brands, cashback willbe applied to your purchase. All you have to do is wait until the end of each billing cycle for cash to land right back into your account.


- Priority customer support:


Dedicated help when you need it, which is available in both English and Arabic.


With Ziina Violet, you’ll get exclusive membership deals and benefits from brands you likely already buy from, such as:


- Ounass:

Receive 30% off rides across the UAE


…and 9 other premium brands. Most benefits refresh automatically each month.

Here are some other Revolut alternatives in the UAE:


## Wio Personal


Wio Personal


1 is a neobank that’s run by Wio Bank and backed by firms like ADQ and First Abu Dhabi Bank.


Key features:


- Open an account online:


You can open a Wio account online with your Emirates ID or UAE visa number – Wio will then verify your identity using a photo of your ID or UAE work visa, along with a selfie.


- Interest and cashback:


Earn up to 6% interest per year with the Family or Salary Plan. You can also spend with a Wio Credit Card and earn up to 2% cashback every time you swipe your card purchase.


- Manage your money in one place:


Wio Personal lets you access your spending, savings, and investments all from the same dashboard.


- Family accounts and Pockets:


Manage money together through a shared account with someone you trust, share cards with family members, and create Pockets for children aged 8–17 to save and spend.


Pricing**:


Wio Personal offers 4 different pricing plans which are made to suit different lifestyles, ranging from 25 AED to 49 AED per month. They also offer a Salary plan, which is free if you transfer your salary into your account every payday.


Wio will waive all subscription fees (regardless of your plan) if you maintain a certain AED balance each month. All transactions outside the UAE (including online) are subject to a 2% currency conversion fee.


## Careem Pay


Careem Pay


2 sits inside the Careem superapp. It acts as a personal digital wallet where you can store money, pay bills, and make international transfers.


To use Careem Pay, you’ll need to verify your identity using an original Emirates ID and a valid UAE visa.


Key features:


- International transfers: Send money abroad or set rate alerts if you need to keep an eye on exchange rates before making your transfer. Careem Pay provides international money transfers through their partnership with Lulu Exchange.


- Quick transfers: Most transfers are verified quickly, and your payee will usually receive their money soon after that. Careem Pay operates 24/7, including weekends and holidays.


- Pay your bills from one place: Find and pay a range of bills through the app, including utility bills, prepaid services, and Salik account top-ups.


- Payments to other Careem users: If your payee doesn’t have the Careem app, they’ll receive a link to download it and complete the transaction.


Pricing:


Please check with Careem Pay for specific pricing.


2a

## Liv Bank


Liv X³ is a digital banking app powered by Liv Bank, which is owned by Emirates NBD. With Liv, you can open a paperless bank account using your Emirates ID, track your daily spending, pay utility bills, and transfer money.


Key features:


- International payments:


Send international payments via the SWIFT or DirectRemit payment networks. Liv lets you send money to lots of countries across the world, with particularly quick transfers to the UK, India, Pakistan, the Philippines, Sri Lanka, and Egypt.


3a
- Bill payments:


You can pay your utility, phone, and other bills quickly through the Liv X app.


- Make transfers using a UAE mobile number:


Send funds between you and your contacts easily using your UAE mobile numbers.


- A debit card and withdrawals:


Create a debit card and make withdrawals from ATMs in the UAE.


- A free cheque book:


Your first cheque book is free when you open a Liv account.


Pricing:


Liv Bank accounts cost 25 AED per month (excluding VAT) unless you transfer a monthly salary of AED 5,000 or more to Liv.


3b Liv might also waive your monthly fee if you’re spending at least AED 2,500 per month with your Liv debit card, have an active Liv credit card, or you keep your monthly average balance above AED 3,000. For more up-to-date information, consult with the provider.


## Wise


Wise


4 is a fintech app that was built for people and businesses who need to send, spend, hold, and receive multiple currencies internationally. It’s a global platform, though in the UAE, some of its features are not fully available, such as a debit card and a local AED IBAN.


4a


Key features:


- Mid-market exchange rates: Wise uses the live mid-market rate and only charges a small, upfront fee, which they’ll show before you make a transfer.


- Volume discounts: If you send more than USD 25,000 (or the equivalent) in one month, Wise will lower their percentage fee. After reaching that amount, you’ll save on all other transfers for the rest of the month.


- 24/7 customer support: Get help from Wise support staff at any time through email, phone, or chat.


Pricing:


How much a transfer costs depends on the amount you’re sending, how you pay, and the exchange rate. Transfer fees generally fall between 0.14% and 0.31% of your transfer amount. The exception to this is if you’re sending a small amount of money, in which case Wise will charge you a minimum fee.


4b
